name: finch-deepseek-api
description: DeepSeek tool APIs for Finch: web search, page reading, and document/image OCR from a single API key.

finch.name: DeepSeek Search & OCR
finch.description: One DeepSeek API key gives Finch web search, page reading as Markdown, and PDF/Office/image OCR.
finch.systemPrompt: When the user needs web search with sources, a specific URL read as Markdown, or OCR of a PDF/Word/PowerPoint file or image, use the deepseek_api tool; if it reports that no API key is configured, call setup_deepseek_api to collect one securely.

promptGuides.prompt: Set up the DeepSeek API tools for Finch.
